pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Holy Armor$(): +3 armor, +1 toughness, +10% knockback resistance. The $(thing)Paladin$() is tanky without giving up as much damage as the $(thing)Vanguard$().$(br2)$(bold)Divine Resilience$(): shield blocking cuts incoming damage further, and all healing sources are +15% more effective.$(br2)$(bold)Healing Aura$(): nearby allies regenerate HP passively, the class's core group utility.

pages.title: Group Play
pages.text: The $(thing)Paladin$() is the only class designed for multiplayer. Healing Aura makes nearby players much more durable, and the tanky stats let the $(thing)Paladin$() hold the front.

pages.title: Group Play, cont.
pages.text: $(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Dwarf$(): fire resistance and heavy armor effectiveness make the best frontliner.$(br)$(thing)Human$(): the Versatile bonus fits any group role.$(br)$(thing)Orc$(): attack speed keeps your damage respectable while you tank.$(br2)$(bold)Next: spend points in the Fortitude tree ($(k:puffish_skills.open)).$()
